calendar.$description: Tokens of `calendar`: its header, its grid and its days. `date-picker` shows one in its popup.

gap.$description: Space between the header and the grid.

heading-font-weight.$description: Font weight of the month and year.

weekday-font-size.$description: Font size of the names of the days.

day-size.$description: Width and height of a day, at the least.

day-border-radius.$description: Corner radius of a day and of the buttons.

day-background-color-hover.$description: Background color of a day or a button under the pointer.

selected-background-color.$description: Background color of the chosen day.

selected-text-color.$description: Text color of the chosen day.

border-width.$description: Border width of today; the chevrons are twice as thick.

chevron-size.$description: Width and height of the chevrons of the previous and next buttons.

disabled-opacity.$description: Opacity of a day outside `min` and `max`.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Space between a day or a button and its focus ring.
